info.title: How is &ha; achieved for &hana; and &sap; applications

abstract.para: Learn about &ha; for &hana; and other &sap; applications included in &sles4sap;.

topic.para: &hana; &ha; uses the Advanced Next Generation Interface (ANGI) resource agents, delivered in the SAPHanaSR-angi package. ANGI supports &hana; XSA, offers faster takeover in certain scenarios, and is more resilient against administration mistakes during maintenance.
&ha; for &sap; application servers uses the simple mount solution, which simplifies the configuration of mount points and makes the setup more robust.
